newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Profiles of Hong Kong's old elite.
newsitem.headline: Profiles of Hong Kong's old elite.

text.p: Hong Kong's last colonial governor Chris Patten chose an eclectic group to sit on his Executive Council, or inner cabinet of key policy advisers.

The presence of Tung Chee-hwa, the billionaire shipping magnate anointed by China to become Hong Kong's next chief executive on July 1, confirms the influence enjoyed by businessmen on the Executive Council under the British.
But members from other walks of life balanced a business perspective with academics and non-executive members of anti-corruption bodies.
Following is a list of Patten's key policy advisers (Tung resigned in June 1996):
Denis CHANG Khen-lee, 52
Barrister at law
Chairman of Police Complaints Committee. Member, ICAC Complaints Committee, Deputy chairman of the Board of Review (Inland Revenue).
Professor Edward CHEN Kwan Yiu, 51
President of Lignan College

Chairman of the Consumer Council. Chairman, Society for the Aged. Non-executive director Securities and Futures Commission. Member of Economic Advisory Committee and Board of the Mass Transit Railway Corporation.
Andrew LI Kwok-nang, 47
Barrister at law
Chairman of the Land Development Corporation. Trustee, Croucher Foundation. Former chairman of the University and Polytechnic Grants Committee.
Professor Felice Lieh MAK, 52
Professor of psychiatry at University of Hong Kong.

Chairman of the Kowloon Regional Advisory Committee of the Hospital Authority. Chairman of the Advisory Committee on Corruption of the ICAC. Chairman of Advisory Committee on Teacher Education and Qualification. Member of the Hospital Authority and the Mental Health Review Tribunal. President of the World Psychiatric Association
Vincent CHENG Hoi-chuen, 47

Executive director of Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp. Managing director of Hang Seng Bank Ltd. Director of Carlingford Lombard Holdings Ltd. Former member of Legco, 1991-1995. Member of Economic Advisory Comittee, Industry & Technology Development Council and Rehabilitation Development Coordinating Committee. Non-executive director of Securities and Futures Commission.
James David MCGREGOR, 72

Director of J.D. McGregor Ltd and HKCB Bank Holding Co Ltd. Former member of Legco 1988-1995. Member of Trade Advisory Board, Economic Review Commitee. Member of the ICAC Operations Committee and the Witness Protection Appeals Board.
Raymong CH'IEN Kuo-fung, 44
Managing director of Lam Soon Hong Kong Group
Chairman of Hong Kong Industrial Technology Centre Corporation. Chairman of the Federation of Hong Kong Industries General Committee. Chairman of the Industry and Technology Development Council.
Rosanna WONG Yick-ming, 43

Executive director of Hong Kong Federation of Youth Groups. Chairman, Hong Kong Housing Authority. Council Member of Hong Kong Council of Social Service, Member of the Fight Crime Committee. Member, Coordinating Committee on Children and Youth Welfare.
